title: Remove deprecated `WS_1004_NO_STATUS_RCVD` and `WS_1005_ABNORMAL_CLOSURE`
description:
- This deprecation was introduced in **Apr 22, 2022** on https://github.com/encode/starlette/pull/1580.

Now, **December 28, 2024**, we are finally removing it. More than 2 years and a half later.
